div.head: Rect 6.1
div.ab: [6.1] On manegum landum stent, þæt he sylle ælce geare XV swyn to sticunge, X ealde 7 V gynge – hæbbe sylf, þæt he ofer þæt arære –; on manegum landum byreð deopre swanriht.
In multis locis stat, ut det singulis annis XV porcos ad occisionem, X ueteres et V iuuenes — ipse autem habeat superaugmentum —; in multis locis est seruilius rectum porcarii.
On manegum landum stent þæt he sylle ælce geare . xv . swyn to sticunge . x. ealde . 7.v. gynge . hæb|be sylf þæt he ofer þæt arære .
On manegum landum stent þæt he sylle ælce geare XV swyn to sticunge, X ealde and V gynge, hæbbe sylf þæt he ofer þæt arære. On manegum landum gebyreð deopre swanriht.

Auf vielen Landgütern gilt, dass er in jedem Jahre [der Herrschaft] 15 Schweine zum Abstechen liefere, 10 ausgewachsene und 5 junge — behalte er selbst, was er darüber aufzüchtet —; auf vielen Landgütern steht schwerere Schweinehirtenpflicht fest.

On many estates it holds that he deliver [to the lord] each year 15 pigs for slaughter, 10 full-grown and 5 young — let him keep himself what he rears beyond that —; on many estates a heavier swineherd's duty is laid down.
On many estates [the custom] stands that he gives each year fifteen pigs for slaughter, ten mature and five young. He has [for] himself [any] that he rears over that [amount].

On many estates, it is the practice that every year he gives fifteen swine for slaughter, ten mature and five young, and that he keep for himself whatever he should raise over that. On many estates, greater obligations are expected from the swineherd.
